_readme: gbpToMwk is kwacha per pound, one figure per YEAR. Entries convert at the rate for their own year, never at today's rate, because the kwacha moved a long way over this period. perGbp is how many units of each other currency one pound buys TODAY, used only for the other display currencies; those are approximate and the site says so. Kwacha figures are always exact, because kwacha is what was actually sent.
